title: hieracium jurassicum subsp. fontanalbae
intro: Hieracium jurassicum subsp. fontanalbae, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species belonging to the dandelion-like plants in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to alleviate conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium jurassicum subsp. fontanalbae include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which contribute to its potential in treating infections and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
